rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR UPPER EXTREMITY COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY ANGIOGRAPHY (CTA) / Upper Extremity Peripheral Vascular Disease (1,2)

criteria.description: Known or suspected acute upper extremity vascular disease or ischemia with ischemic ulceration or acute sustained loss of perfusion

required_documentation: Vascular surgery or physical examination documenting pulse deficits, ischemic ulcers, or abnormal arterial Doppler studies
rules.review_notes: Upper extremity CTA indicated for upper extremity peripheral vascular disease and ischemia.
